description.zh: 要修改的访问控制策略组ID。
description.en: The ID of the ACL that you want to modify.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

description.zh: IPv6转换服务实例的地域。 您可以通过调用 DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID。
description.en: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

title.zh: 修改访问控制策略组的名称

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc modify-ipv6-translator-acl-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --acl-id ipv6transacl-bp1de20000 --acl-name acl1 --region cn-hangzhou
